basics.name: Alexander Prytula
basics.label: Full-stack Software Engineer | Technical Lead
basics.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 8+ years of experience building product features across React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, and Go. Works comfortably from frontend UI modernization through backend services, APIs, microservices, CI/CD, testing, and production reliability. Brings a technical-lead mindset to architecture, delivery, and mentoring while staying hands-on in implementation.
